name: DYSFUTUR3.05
source:
Solaris carries the weight of a human past in a mechanical body. With every choice, she explores memory, loss, and the fleeting beauty of life. As time runs out, the line between human and machine blurs, revealing the cost and meaning of existence.

[From [url=https://nouzivr.itch.io/dysfutur305]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
索拉里斯以一具机械之躯背负着属于人类的沉重过往。在每一次抉择之中，她不断探索着记忆、失去，以及转瞬即逝的生命之美。随着时间所剩无几，人类与机械之间的界限日渐模糊，揭示出存在的代价与真谛。

[摘自[url=https://nouzivr.itch.io/dysfutur305]Itch.io[/url]]
